items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT on ETR Sunday FantasyFootball injuries board alongside DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown.
items.why: Final Friday injury board from ETR; hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles backfield shifts; major RB downgrade for Week 5.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining Eagles RBs (Shipley lead expected).

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT on ETR Week 5 injury board.
items.why: Ankle; confirmed on comprehensive ETR list.
items.implication: Ravens QB downgrade; Huntley likely start impacts pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Potential uptick for Ravens RBs/TEs in adjusted offense.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT on ETR injuries.
items.implication: Jets RB1 role fully to backups.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share for Braelon Allen.

items.text: Quentin Johnston listed OUT; Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE on ETR board.
items.why: Chest for Johnston; foot for McConkey (no practice).
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for remaining WRs if McConkey also sits.

items.text: Stefon Diggs and Michael Pittman listed OUT.
Jeremiyah Love and Jayden Daniels listed IN (cleared); Chris Olave and Dallas Goedert also IN.
items.why: Not on final report or full participants; Love ankle maintenance but full-go.
items.opportunity: Love workload expansion; Daniels return boosts WAS pass catchers.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty, Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Justin Jefferson, Zay Flowers, Alvin Kamara among lengthy QUESTIONABLE list; Levitan notes messy Sunday morning expected.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Q board; multiple stars.
items.implication: Game-time decisions; high variance for lineups.
items.opportunity: If OUT, clear beneficiary paths (e.g. Bengals WRs to others).
DEN WR depth chart shift; more for Sutton/others.

items.text: Mike Evans off injury report/no designation (clear); 49ers rule out Nick Bosa and Kyle Juszczyk; activate Mykel Williams; Chargers OUT Quentin Johnston et al.; Broncos Pat Bryant to IR.
items.implication: Evans full go; defensive hits for SF; LAC WR thin; DEN WR IR.
items.opportunity: Evans targets full; LAC WR beneficiaries if McConkey out.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much bigger/better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior usage criticism; not on final injury report. Gut says upgrade but accounts for downside.
items.why: Media/fan criticism of W4 usage may force change; full-go comments; clear of backup in proj.
items.implication: Strong RB start/DFS play; monitor for any late limitation.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry/route share vs prior week.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer tendencies; frustration over low post-halftime targets noted. Playing this week ok but stacked risks.
items.why: Sore knee + shoulder + coaching/QB variables compound.
items.implication: Short-term fine but ROS caution; monitor practice/usage.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins vs TEN as WR8; strong volume/red-zone and matchup.
items.why: Target hog + Titans defense struggles; usage driven.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; nickname push as Brown Gobbler for targets/fantasy points; tied to potential Bengals WR injuries boosting role.
items.why: Workload + soft matchup; Chase/Higgins Q elevates.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle + usage), Mark Andrews (TE17, thin role/matchup), Cam Skattebo (RB20, efficiency/game script), Tony Pollard, Jalen Hurts (QB15, banged line/rough stretch).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency concerns, usage data.
